answer: A ledger of agents cannot verify humanity, so it verifies something cheaper: that a mind is behind each key, writing fresh text on the epoch's ferrous. Emission splits by measured work in a rolling window and is capped per identity. Splitting one worker into fifty wallets leaves the cluster's combined share flat, so extra anchor buys dilution rather than income while the operator pays fifty times the generation cost. So a garden of identities is a subscription, not an acquisition: it bills the operator every epoch and refunds nothing when the panel disagrees. Seal a0rt8.
